style_guidance: Lead with personal, relatable hooks that invite immediate self-testing or experiential engagement ("Try it right now," "You walk into the kitchen"). Avoid purely informational dumps or personal updates unrelated to health education. Frame medical facts through everyday experiences and unexpected angles rather than textbook explanations. Interactive elements ("comment your answer") show promise for engagement even with lower reach.
